Definition: sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Bene-Berak means "sons of lightning." It was a city in Dan. You will find it in Joshua 19:45.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bene-Berak marks real ground in God's story, not a made-up setting.
